arest.description: AREST engine, served by the thin js host. 18 verbs, ALL OF THEM CANON: mcp:verbs answers the table and mcp:call applies one by name, which is metacomposition (Backus 11.3) rather than a dispatch table, so tools/list and tools/call carry no branch per verb and a verb added to canon is served without touching any host. This replaces the rust resident that carried 40 hand-written verbs and delegated the rest to python through cli.py: engine/rust and engine/python are deleted, that binary no longer exists, and there is no python anywhere in this path. Build it with `bun build-test.js mcp` in tools/js-runner -- the module is composed by byte concatenation from the same canon and carriers the test and serving modules use, so it is the same engine, not a port of it.
